acceptanceCriteria: The estimate and its age appear in dispatch status.
Unknown usage never triggers a stop.
The hard stop hands off a live attempt with a recorded reason.
Each crossing is recorded once per session.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1007 (author ls-russell-lewis, opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Existing budgets only gate launches. Proposal: per-role context {warnTokens, handoffTokens, hardTokens}; the dispatcher reads usage from recognised host event streams, exposes warn/handoff notices to the worker, and past hard releases the attempt with a clean HANDOFF and stops the worker. See beamfall/corvint#1007 for the full problem, current workaround and proposal.
title: corvint-tasks dispatch: per-role context-size warn/handoff/hard thresholds for running sessions (issue #1007)
